Name: Profit Margins
Author: ChroniclerCherry
TagLine: Lets you change the profit margin anytime by editing a config file.
Description:
This mod lets you change the [game's profit margins](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Multiplayer#Profit_margins) (which rebalance prices throughout the game to raise or lower difficulty), just by editing the mod's config file. Without this mod, you'd normally need manual save editing to change them.

Already a year into the run but finding that you're drowning in money and losing the feel of a challenge? Just reduce the profit margins!

**Install**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**How to use**
Open the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file (which is generated when you run the game with the mod) in a text editor to set the desired settings:

*   [font=Courier New]EnableInMultiplayer[/font]: Whether the mod should apply when hosting a multiplayer save. If false, it only applies in single-player. Default false.

*   [font=Courier New]ProfitMargin[/font]: The percentage profit margins as a decimal value, where 1 (i.e. 100%) is the default value. For example, setting this to 0.5 will set 50% profit margins (more difficult), while 2 will set 200% profit margins (easier). Default 1.
**Common questions**

> **Is the mod still compatible?**
> The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

> **Does the mod conflict with any others?**
> There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.

> **Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?**
> Yep. The profit margins will remain at whatever value you last set for each save. If you want to undo the change, set the profit margins back to the desired value and then save once before removing the mod.
